claims: 從來沒…過 is a natural Mandarin pattern for emphatic experiential negation.
沒 negates experiential 過 while 過 remains; the construction does not merely encode simple past.

sources.citation: Ross, C., & Ma, J.-h. S. Modern Mandarin Chinese Grammar: A Practical Guide, §17.3.
Chinese Grammar Wiki (AllSet Learning), expressing never with 從來.

claims: 曾經 commonly combines with V過 for prior experience.

sources.citation: Ross, C., & Ma, J.-h. S. Modern Mandarin Chinese Grammar: A Practical Guide, §17.3.
Merry Mandarin Grammar Lab, 曾經.

claims: 有 + V is documented in Taiwan Mandarin.
Taiwan Mandarin includes 有 + V過 usage.
The entry correctly marks the construction as regional, not exclusive.

sources.citation: Yang, Y.-X. (2019). The Syntactic and Pragmatic Characteristics of the Construction “you zai V” in Taiwan Mandarin. NTU. DOI 10.6342/NTU201900465.
Learn Teochew, Grammatical Differences in Taiwanese Mandarin, example 我有去過那個地方.

entries.notes: R44 audit: PASS_NO_CHANGE; Taiwan-specific framing supported.

claims: 沒 + V + 過 is standard experiential negation.
The entry correctly distinguishes absence of experience from a simple past negation.

sources.citation: Ross, C., & Ma, J.-h. S. Modern Mandarin Chinese Grammar: A Practical Guide, §17.3.
Chinese Grammar Wiki (AllSet Learning), expressing never with 從來.

claims: V過 marks experiential aspect without requiring a specified time.
過 is not a past-tense ending and contrasts aspectually with 了.

sources.citation: Ross, C., & Ma, J.-h. S. Modern Mandarin Chinese Grammar: A Practical Guide, §17.3.
